notes: Per-site per-variable old-vs-fresh comparison for P_ERA, P_F, TA_ERA, TA_F, NEE_VUT_REF, GPP_NT_VUT_REF, LE_F_MDS, H_F_MDS. Severity classification uses a fixed absolute-difference floor per variable (2 units for met vars, 10 for flux vars), not a ratio, since NEE/TA cross zero and a ratio is unreliable there. Superseded an earlier version of this script with two classification bugs (both documented in-line): conflating any uniform tiny drift with a severe uniform factor, then a ratio-only threshold that mislabeled zero-crossing variables.
